blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump has left the Philippines after a brief visit to the country. Air Force One departed Manila at 2:35 p.m. on Wednesday, according to information shared with journalists. Trump is heading to Shenzhen, China, to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting, where he is expected to take part in an unprecedented trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump arrived in Manila on Tuesday evening for several engagements with leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean). Before that, he also met with the leaders of […]...
